text_encoder: Qwen3-8B int8 + CLIP float32; encoders unloaded before motion inference

clips.name: idle
clips.prompt: A person stands relaxed in place, breathing gently, shifting weight slightly, arms resting naturally at the sides.

clips.name: run
clips.prompt: A basketball player runs forward at a steady pace, pumping bent arms naturally, alternating strong strides, remaining upright.

clips.name: dribble
clips.prompt: A basketball player runs forward while repeatedly dribbling a basketball with the right hand, knees slightly bent, left arm balancing.

clips.name: defense
clips.prompt: A basketball defender crouches in place, feet wide, knees bent, arms spread, making small lateral weight shifts while guarding.

clips.name: shoot
clips.prompt: A basketball player bends the knees, raises both hands above the forehead, jumps and shoots, extending the right elbow and flicking the wrist.

clips.name: pass
clips.prompt: A basketball player holds both hands near the chest, then extends both arms forward for a strong chest pass and returns upright.

clips.name: dunk
clips.prompt: A basketball player bends the knees, jumps high, raises the right arm overhead, slams a basketball downward, then lands with bent knees.

clips.name: block
clips.prompt: A basketball defender jumps straight up with both arms fully extended overhead to block a shot, then lands on both feet.

clips.name: steal
clips.prompt: A basketball defender crouches, lunges slightly forward and reaches the right hand low to swipe a ball, then returns to a balanced stance.

clips.name: stun
clips.prompt: A person staggers backward after being bumped, flings both arms outward for balance, bends the knees, and recovers without falling.

clips.name: layup
clips.prompt: A basketball player takes two running steps, jumps off the left foot, lifts the right knee, extends the right arm upward to gently lay the ball into the basket with one hand, then lands and recovers.

processing: source 6D columns converted with upstream rot6d_to_rotation_matrix
quaternions stored in Godot XYZW order
loop cycle selected by pose similarity
peak wrist pose tagged for gameplay event alignment
